newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Mar 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Mar 16.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) leader and former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia on Saturday said the governent had appointed "incompetent" persons in different key positions.
The concept of the proposed four-nation sub-regional cooperation is likely to be finalised through an agreement on April 2 following a three-day meeting of foreign secretaries in Kathmandu.

Four activists of the Jatiyatabadi Chhatra Dal (JCD), the student front of the opposition BNP, received bullet injury in the Dhaka University campus on Saturday when an armed group of another JCD faction opened fire on them.
Opposition leader and former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia said on Saturday she would announce a "tough" action programme against the government on April 3.
Foreign Minister Abdus Samad Azad will pay a three-day official visit to the Republic of Korea, beginning April 2.
Bangladeshis will receive $11.3 million from the UN Compensation Commission as compensation for their departure from Iraq and Kuwait during the gulf war.
Bangladesh is losing its export competitiveness in the leather and footwear sector because of its overvalued taka in relation to Pakistani and Indian currencies, business circle said.
Country's 68 percent passengers and commodities are now being transported through roads and highways. REUTER
